src.label: Australian Department of Agriculture (Micor) — Cambodia, dogs (contact for the Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries)

head: No published rule set: ask the Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries.
lines: The Australian agriculture department says Cambodia's health requirements are those set by the importing country and directs exporters to the Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries at info@maff.gov.kh.
If the ministry issues an import permit, the animal must meet everything written in it.
The Australian entry was last reviewed in June 2021, so it only points to the right office; confirm the rules and any quarantine step with the ministry before travel.
